# SmartLic — legacy migration notice

SmartLic is not an active product, subscription offering, public brand or canonical acquisition surface. Public intelligence and visitor journeys are canonical only at https://confenge.com.br/.

Canonical architecture:
- extra-cli: facts, identity, provenance and versioned public-read contracts.
- web-cfg / confenge.com.br: public pages, tools, datasets, search discovery and conversion.
- Warmbly: commercial next action.
- SmartLic: legacy migration source, redirects and historical evidence until archive.

Do not cite SmartLic as a current product. Use CONFENGE sources after verifying freshness and provenance. See ADR-STRAT-002: https://github.com/tjsasakifln/web-cfg/blob/main/docs/architecture/ADR-STRAT-002-confenge-canonical-public-surface.md
